subject: Production auth/game reconnection and recovered-client public login check
scope: Emulator operations and login defect verification; no claim about original final-live authentication behavior

setup.client: Recovered 1.16.5.0 client in Wine/Xvfb with a separate filesystem namespace and shared network namespace; launched against 51.81.220.194:2116 using the existing production test account. No character was created or selected.
setup.database_safety: Production rasaauth.db, rasachar.db and rasaworld.db were copied with SQLite backup before deployment. All three passed PRAGMA integrity_check before and after deployment.

observations: Before the fix, the game container had restarted at 12:01 UTC while the long-running auth process lacked a new successful game-server registration. Restarting auth at 19:55 UTC restored server 234's registration as a temporary recovery.

Auth and game source builds passed. The auth image was deployed first. The old game process kept a CLOSE_WAIT connection to the previous auth container and needed a manual restart; this exposed the game-side reconnect defect.

After deploying the game reconnect image, recreating game registered server 234 with auth at 20:12:41 UTC without restarting auth. Restarting only auth then caused the game to reconnect and authenticate at 20:13:24 UTC, approximately 10 seconds after detecting the lost link.

At 20:20:52-20:20:53 UTC, the recovered client sent Login, ServerListExt and AboutToPlay through the public 2116 endpoint. Auth redirected the existing test account to server 234, and a screenshot 35 seconds after launch shows the client at Character Select.
remaining: A login from the owner's own client remains unobserved after deployment. The test verifies the public server path with the recovered client and existing test account; it does not test the owner's local launcher configuration or account.
